title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(井田次郎研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Ida Jiro)
keywords: Semiconductor Properties 2.Semiconductor Devices 3.Integrated Circuit 4.Simulations 5.Ultra Low Power Applications
educationalGoal: Student will research on topics of semiconductor devices and integrated circuits, especially dealing with silicon semiconductor devices. Along with this project, student will learn all aspects of engineering skill, such as searching current technology status, knowhow of collecting technological information, setting theme, proceeding research, presentation, and so on. Student will publish graduation thesis as a summary of the project and present thesis on public announcement.
advice: Project will do with one or group. Weekly meeting. First half of year: Start basic experiments. Weekly presentation on progress. Second half of year: Fix own theme and research. Weekly presentation on progress of research. Publish graduation thesis and presentation. Examples of topics (1)Ultra low power MOS device (2)Device research for RF energy harvesting (3)Neuromorphic devices
requiredKnowledge: Understanding and knowledge of Electronic Engineering Course, such as, “Electromagnetics”, “Electronic circuit”, “Electronic Engineering”, “Physical Electronics”, “Semiconductor Engineering”, and “Optical and Electronic devices”

activityGoals.body: Be able to define the objective of research, understand topics of research and plan the reseach.
Be able to progress the research, by communicating with professor and group members
Be able to resolve issues of research by oneself
Be able to publish thesis of research
Be able to explain and present the research, clearly.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい。     授業明細   回数 学習内容 授業の運営方法 学習課題(予習・復習) 時間:分※       Achieving project with coaching by professor.        研究室でのゼミ活動と個別指導を合わせて90時間以上とする。
